card.name: Return and result in API docs
card.fires_on: The word return, returns or result when programming documentation describes what a function gives back, as in 'The return result' or 'function's return value'.

modes.label: return as noun or verb
modes.description: The word return or returns in a description of a function's output.
modes.example: The value of errno should only be examined when it is indicated to be valid by a function's<< return>> value.

modes.label: result or value after return
modes.description: The word result or value naming what a function produces.
modes.example: The value of this variable will be replaced with the<< result>> of the operation.

card.writes: It nudges toward the word result and away from unrelated foreign-language tokens, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on 'return' and 'result' when software manuals describe what a function hands back.
